responsibility: Implements the gcov-tool command-line driver for offline manipulation of gcda profile data. This file parses subcommands and options, orchestrates reading profile directories or streams, merges profiles with weights, rewrites or normalizes/scales them, computes profile overlap, removes stale output gcda files, and writes resulting gcov_info data back out. It is the front-end CLI layer that connects user operations to lower-level profile merge/analysis routines.
